model.rawSql:
SELECT s.*, info.name AS name, info.provider AS provider FROM (
SELECT service, message, 1 AS unhealthy FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, argMax(multiIf(Body = 'Provider reports the service as healthy', 'healthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as degraded', 'degraded',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as unhealthy', 'unhealthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service health as unknown', 'unknown', ''), Timestamp) AS state,
    argMax(LogAttributes['message'], Timestamp) AS message, max(Timestamp) AS since
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND multiIf(Body = 'Provider reports the service as healthy', 'healthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as degraded', 'degraded',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service as unhealthy', 'unhealthy',
    Body = 'Provider reports the service health as unknown', 'unknown', '') != ''
  GROUP BY service) WHERE state = 'unhealthy') AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info USING service

model.rawSql:
SELECT s.*, info.name AS name, info.provider AS provider FROM (
SELECT service, left(argMaxIf(err, last_check, err != ''), 200) AS cause, count() AS unconfirmed FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, LogAttributes['backupId'] AS backup,
    minIf(Timestamp, if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) = 'Backup initiation successful') AS initiated,
    countIf(if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) = 'Backup confirmation successful') AS confirmed,
    maxIf(Timestamp, startsWith(if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']), 'Backup confirmation Failed')) AS last_check,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['error'], Timestamp, startsWith(if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']), 'Backup confirmation Failed')) AS err
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 25 HOUR AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND LogAttributes['backupId'] != ''
    AND if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) IN ('Backup initiation successful', 'Backup confirmation successful', 'Backup confirmation Failed: Backup does not exist yet', 'Backup confirmation Failed: Error')
  GROUP BY service, backup)
WHERE confirmed = 0 AND initiated < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND initiated > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY service) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info USING service

The backup store may be unreachable or reject the credentials. Fires before the backups are overdue; the marketplace stops checking a backup after a day.

rules.title: Managed service resource close to plan limit

model.rawSql:
SELECT s.*, info.name AS name, info.provider AS provider FROM (
SELECT service, resource, message AS used, 1 AS close FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, extract(Body, '^Utilization of (.+) is (?:normal|close to the plan value|at the plan value)$') AS resource, argMax(multiIf(endsWith(Body, ' is normal'), 'normal', endsWith(Body, ' is close to the plan value'), 'closeToLimit', endsWith(Body, ' is at the plan value'), 'atLimit', ''), Timestamp) AS state,
    argMax(LogAttributes['message'], Timestamp) AS message, max(Timestamp) AS since
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND multiIf(endsWith(Body, ' is normal'), 'normal', endsWith(Body, ' is close to the plan value'), 'closeToLimit', endsWith(Body, ' is at the plan value'), 'atLimit', '') != ''
  GROUP BY service, extract(Body, '^Utilization of (.+) is (?:normal|close to the plan value|at the plan value)$') AS resource) WHERE state = 'closeToLimit') AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info USING service

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.resource }} of {{ $labels.provider }} service {{ if $labels.name }}{{ $labels.name }}{{ else }}{{ $labels.service }}{{ end }} is close to the plan value ({{ $labels.used }})
annotations.description: Raise the plan before it is used up; for storage the service stops accepting writes once it is full.

model.rawSql:
SELECT s.*, info.name AS name, info.provider AS provider FROM (
SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service, if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) AS event,
  multiIf(positionCaseInsensitive(event, 'backup') > 0, 'backup', positionCaseInsensitive(event, 'restore') > 0, 'restore', positionCaseInsensitive(event, 'autoscal') > 0, 'autoscaling', positionCaseInsensitive(event, 'reconcil') > 0, 'reconciliation', 'operation') AS operation,
  left(argMax(if(LogAttributes['error'] != '', LogAttributes['error'], LogAttributes['message']), Timestamp), 200) AS cause,
  count() AS failures FROM otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != '' AND SeverityNumber >= 17 AND NOT (startsWith(Body, 'Provider reports the service') OR startsWith(Body, 'Backups are ') OR startsWith(Body, 'Utilization of '))
GROUP BY service, event, operation) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'] AS service,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['provider'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['provider'] != '') AS provider,
    argMaxIf(LogAttributes['name'], Timestamp, LogAttributes['name'] != '') AS name
  FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] != ''
  GROUP BY service) AS info USING service
